result.summary: Found 1 minor visual/content issue. The rest of the page appears visually consistent; partially visible horizontal carousel items and bottom viewport clipping were treated as expected behavior.

issues.description: A promotion badge on the partially visible restaurant card shows “-0%”, which looks like an invalid or placeholder discount value.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or display a meaningful promotion such as “€0 delivery” or a valid percentage discount.
